safetyNotes: Official page explicitly warns hikers to take great care crossing highway/road 15 around route km 1.2.
Knäred to Timmershult uses forest trails and climbs steadily; coming from the south this is a descent.
After Timmershult the route is mostly easier roads of various types, with short path sections, farms/open agricultural land and Smedjeån valley context.
Official accessibility text says no obstacles and bridges are present when crossing waterways, while boardwalks can have deeper surrounding water.

Local Hjörnered/Knäred sources mention possible fallen trees, lush vegetation, flooded passages, muddy/icy/stony local trails and hilly terrain; do not overstate as current full-route hazards without field confirmation.
Dogs should be leashed; Västralt and Oxhult reserve rules strengthen this.
Hunting may occur August-January; use bright clothing, stay on marked trail, keep dogs leashed and use arranged campsites.
S8 follows roads past farms; close gates, keep dogs close and avoid cultivated land.

sourceContradictions.details: S8 place feed includes Krokån camp/toilet/mill/slipränna and Dödsröset/Knäreds kyrkoruin, which are north/off the S8 line and better tied to S7/start-area context.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Import Knäred start services and access; suppress Krokån/S7 records from S8 core unless the app has start-area side-context modeling.

sourceContradictions.details: Gula villan is an official seasonal water point. Västralt text says nearest water is Gula villan. No official drinking-water POI was found at Ekegården, while local general text/blog context may imply signposted or nearby water at shelters.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Import Gula villan as water; do not import Ekegården or Västralt as drinking water without another official/current point-level source. Add carry-water caveat.

sourceContradictions.details: Official trail source names Hållplats Knäred; OSM/GTFS-derived stop data labels the closest stop/platform as Smedjebacken.
sourceContradictions.resolution: Import official trail access place and/or OSM Smedjebacken as the exact stop area with naming caveat.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Strong enough for section JSON after first six-lane batch. Remaining issues are documented import caveats rather than missing source coverage: stale line.geometry/Naturkartan/OSM suppression, 2024 reroute/currentness, Ekegården access/water verification, protected-area overlay verification and start-area facility filtering.

importReadiness.identity: ready: canonical official identity is Knäred - Ekegården, Södra delleden section 8 / official order 24, 25 km, medium/blue, no official walking time.
importReadiness.appDescriptionDraft: From Knäred the trail crosses Lagan and road 15, then climbs on forest paths toward Västralt and Timmershult before continuing through beech forest, small roads, farms and short path sections. Vippentorpet, Midsommarstugan and Hjörneredssjöarna give the middle part cultural and landscape interest. The final kilometres follow the Smedjeån area past Horsabäck, the salmon ladder and royal fern before reaching the Ekegården shelter and the handoff to Koarp.
importReadiness.geometry: ready with caveats: official GPX/API geo_json is canonical 342-point navigation-grade geometry; Hallandsleden line.geometry, Naturkartan visible metadata and OSM relation 7396990 are stale/partial/legacy and must be suppressed.
importReadiness.endpoints: ready with caveats: Knäred start stitches to S7 within about 5.3 m and Ekegården end stitches to S9 exactly; decide stop naming for Hållplats Knäred/Smedjebacken.
importReadiness.commuteAccess: ready with caveats: Knäred start transit is strong; Ekegården endpoint transit is weak/remote and should be modeled as shelter/road-access/pickup/continuation access unless later live transit/access research improves it.
importReadiness.facilities: ready with caveats: core official facilities are sourced and coordinate-checked; suppress or side-filter Krokån/S7 carryover and Hjörnered side-area records; verify commercial operations before public use.
importReadiness.water: ready with seasonality/water-gap caveats: Gula villan is official seasonal water 15 Apr-15 Oct; no official drinking water was found at Västralt or Ekegården, so carry-water guidance is needed.
importReadiness.campingFire: ready with dynamic caveats: Västralt and Ekegården shelters/camps are core official facilities; firewood/fireplace use depends on live fire-risk/fire-ban status and reserve rules.
importReadiness.rulesSafety: ready with dynamic caveats: import Knäreds VV water-protection span, Smedjeån Skönhult reserve span, nearby Västralt/Oxhult cautions, road 15 warning, 2024 reroute/stale-map note, forestry/currentness and dynamic fire/dog/hunting checks.
importReadiness.fieldReports: usable: no active closure found; 2024 official reroute, stale 18 km route sources, local terrain/condition context and future Västralt solar-park watch documented.
